 4 hours ago Liverpool make seven changes for tonight’s Carabao Cup fourth-round tie with Chelsea at Anfield.
 By James Carroll
 Previous Next Only Ronald Araujo, Cody Gakpo, Ryan Gravenberch and Virgil van Dijk retain their places in the side from Sunday’s win over Brighton & Hove Albion.
 Liverpool: Mamardashvili, Gomez, Van Dijk, Gakpo, Tsimikas, Araujo, Gravenberch, Nyoni, McConnell, Koumas, Ngumoha.
 Subs: Alisson, Endo, Jacquet, Wirtz, Isak, Mac Allister, Chiesa, Barcola, Chambers.
